newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-WEST INDIES 102-2 IN 2ND INNINGS V AUSTRALIA XI.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WEST INDIES 102-2 IN 2ND INNINGS V AUSTRALIA XI.

text.p: by 227 on the first innings, were 102 for two in their second
innings at close of play on the third day of their four-day
match against an Australia XI at Bellerive Oval on Sunday.
Scores: West Indies 317 (Courtney Browne 93 not out) and 102
for two; Australia XI 544 for four declared (Matthew Hayden 224,
Matthew Elliott 158, Greg Blewett 89 not out).
